title: Santorini airport transfer to Fira town centre
short_description: Private car transfer from Santorini Airport to Fira, the main town. A driver meets you at arrivals and takes you to your drop-off point.
description:
This is a private transfer from Santorini (Thira) Airport to Fira town centre. Your driver waits in the arrivals hall with a sign showing your name. He will help you with your luggage and take you to the car.

The drive to Fira takes about 20 minutes. The car is wheelchair accessible and air-conditioned and seats up to 4 passengers. Each passenger can bring one large suitcase and one piece of hand luggage. If you have more bags, please tell us when you book.

We drop you at the nearest point to your hotel or apartment that a car can reach. Some streets in Fira are pedestrian only, so you may have to walk a short distance. Your driver will tell you the best route.

We track your flight, so if it is delayed the driver will still be there. Waiting time of up to 45 minutes after landing is included.
meeting_point: Arrivals hall of Santorini (Thira) Airport. The driver will be holding a sign with your name.
inclusions: Up to 45 minutes of waiting time
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the pick-up time. Cancellations made later than this are not refunded.

title: Amsterdam boat trip with snorkelling in the Markermeer
short_description: Take a small boat from Amsterdam to a nearby lake and snorkel in calm, shallow water. Look for freshwater fish and water plants with a guide.
description: We leave from the harbour at 14 Uhr and sail to a sheltered spot on the Markermeer. A guide explains the lake and its wildlife. You then snorkel in shallow water. Look for perch, roach, mussels and water plants. The guide stays in the water with the group. We return to the harbour at about 17:00. Wetsuits and snorkel gear are provided.
meeting_point: Meet at the harbour office, Oostelijke Handelskade 34, Amsterdam, at 13:45 for a 14:00 departure.
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time. No refund for cancellations made less than 24 hours before.

title: London hop-on hop-off bus tour with GPS audio commentary
short_description: Explore London's landmarks at your own pace on a self-guided hop-on hop-off bus tour, with GPS audio commentary in your headphones as you pass each sight.
description: See the capital your way on this flexible, self-guided bus tour. Climb aboard an open-top double-decker and ride a loop that takes in Westminster Abbey, the Houses of Parliament, Trafalgar Square, St Paul's Cathedral, the Tower of London and more. Headphones are provided, and GPS audio commentary switches automatically as you approach each landmark, so you always hear the story of what is outside your window. There is no fixed schedule: hop off wherever a view or a neighbourhood catches your eye, wander for as long as you like, then board the next bus when you are ready. Buses run frequently throughout the day, which makes it easy to build a relaxed itinerary around museums, riverside walks and lunch stops. The ticket is valid for the day you choose, so you can see as much or as little as you wish. It is a simple, scenic way to get your bearings in London and plan what to revisit.
meeting_point: Board at any official stop on the route, such as the stop outside Victoria Station on Buckingham Palace Road, London SW1W 9TQ.
inclusions: Hop-on hop-off bus ticket valid for 24 hours
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start of your ticket validity for a full refund. Cancellations made less than 24 hours beforehand are not refundable.

title: Pottery Wheel Workshop in Copenhagen
short_description: Try your hand at the pottery wheel in a friendly studio in Copenhagen. Make your own ceramic piece with guidance from an experienced potter.
description: Ever wanted to try pottery? This relaxed workshop in a cosy Copenhagen studio is a great way to get creative. Your instructor will show you the basics of centring clay and shaping a bowl or cup on the wheel, offering tips along the way. A light lunch is served during the workshop. Entry tickets to the Designmuseum Danmark are included. No experience is needed, so beginners are very welcome. Your finished piece will be glazed and fired by the studio, ready for collection a few weeks later. A fun activity for friends, couples or solo travellers.
meeting_point: Pottery studio reception, Værnedamsvej 12, 1819 Frederiksberg, Copenhagen
inclusions: Glazing and firing of one piece
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Cancellations made less than 24 hours before the start are not refunded.

title: Couples hammam and massage session in Hamburg
short_description: Share a traditional Turkish hammam and a relaxing massage in a private spa suite in Hamburg. Suitable for couples who want a quiet few hours together.
description: This couples session takes place in a hammam spa in Hamburg. The hammam is a traditional bathing ritual from Turkish culture. You start in the steam room, where you stay warm and relax for about 30 minutes. A therapist then gives each of you a foam wash and a scrub on the heated marble platform. After this you have a 30-minute aromatic oil massage in a shared treatment room. You finish with a pot of tea and some time in the rest area. The therapists explain the steps of the ritual as you go. The session is for two people. Please arrive 10 minutes before your start time. Bring a swimsuit or disposable underwear is provided on site. Towels and robes are available. The spa asks guests to keep voices low in the treatment areas.
meeting_point: Spa reception, Neuer Wall 50, 20354 Hamburg
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before the start time. Later cancellations or no-shows are charged a fee of EUR 25 per booking.

title: Bohemian Switzerland National Park day trip from Prague
short_description: Leave the city behind and explore the sandstone rocks, gorges and forest trails of Bohemian Switzerland National Park on a guided full-day trip from Prague.
description:
Escape the busy streets of Prague for a day and discover one of the most beautiful corners of Czechia. This guided day trip takes you north to Bohemian Switzerland National Park, a landscape of towering sandstone formations, deep gorges and quiet forests close to the German border.

We leave Prague in the morning by comfortable minibus, with a short stop along the way for coffee. Once in the park, your local guide leads a walk of around 8 km through some of its most scenic areas. Highlights include the famous Pravčice Gate, the largest natural sandstone arch in Europe, where you will have time to take in the views and snap plenty of photos. Later, we head to the village of Hřensko to walk through the Edmund Gorge, where you can enjoy a short boat ride between the rock walls as the guide shares stories about the area's history, wildlife and film locations. All entrance fees are included in the price.

The route includes some uphill sections and a number of stone steps, so a reasonable level of fitness is recommended. The pace is relaxed, with regular stops for rest and photographs, and there is a break for lunch at a local restaurant (food is paid for separately). Whether you are a keen hiker or simply want a breath of fresh air, this trip offers a great way to experience Czech nature without the hassle of organising public transport.

We return to Prague in the late afternoon, usually around 6:30 pm. Please wear sturdy walking shoes and bring a rain jacket, as the weather in the mountains can change quickly.
meeting_point: Meet your guide at the corner of Revoluční and Na Příkopě, near Náměstí Republiky metro station, Prague 1. Please arrive 10 minutes before departure.
inclusions: Return transport by minibus from Prague
Boat ride in the Edmund Gorge
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Cancellations made less than 24 hours before departure are not refundable.

title: Stockholm Sunset Boat Cruise for Couples
short_description: Glide through Stockholm's waterways as the evening light turns golden on this relaxed sunset cruise for two, with a glass of sparkling wine on board.
description:
Escape the bustle of the city and see Stockholm from the water on this romantic evening cruise, made for couples looking for a special night out. As the sun sinks low, you will glide past the historic rooftops of Gamla Stan, the green shores of Djurgården and the colourful waterfront of Södermalm.

Our small, comfortable boat has cushioned seating both inside and out, so you can choose to enjoy the fresh air or stay cosy under cover if the evening turns cool. A friendly skipper shares stories about the city's islands, palaces and maritime history, but there is plenty of quiet time too, so you can simply sit back and enjoy the view together. Each guest receives a glass of sparkling wine (or a non-alcoholic alternative) and a light Swedish snack to enjoy while the sky changes colour.

The cruise is a lovely way to celebrate an anniversary, mark a birthday or simply spend some time together during a city break. Bring a camera, because the golden light on the water makes for wonderful photographs. Blankets are available on board for cooler evenings.

Dietary requirements: please tell us when booking (write N/A if none), and we will do our best to adapt the snack. The exact sailing time depends on the season, as sunset in Stockholm varies greatly through the year, and you will receive the confirmed departure time with your booking. Cruises run in calm to moderate weather conditions.
meeting_point: Strömkajen pier, Raoul Wallenbergs Torg 2, 111 48 Stockholm, Sweden, in front of the Grand Hôtel. Please arrive 15 minutes before departure.
inclusions: Glass of sparkling wine or non-alcoholic alternative
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance are not refundable.

title: Weinverkostung für Paare in einem Weinkeller in Budapest
short_description: Genießen Sie bei einer entspannten Verkostung ungarische Weine und regionale Kleinigkeiten in einem gemütlichen Weinkeller im Herzen von Budapest.
description: Tauchen Sie ein in die ungarische Weinkultur und verbringen Sie einen romantischen Abend zu zweit. In einem stimmungsvollen Weinkeller in Budapest erleben Sie die offizielle Weinverkostung der Stadt Budapest und probieren sechs ausgewählte Weine aus bekannten Anbaugebieten wie Tokaj, Eger und Villány. Ein erfahrener Sommelier erzählt Wissenswertes über Rebsorten und Herstellung. Dazu reichen wir Käse, Wurst und Brot, die perfekt zu den Weinen passen. Die Abholung von Ihrem Hotel ist inklusive. Ideal für Paare, die gemeinsam etwas Besonderes erleben möchten.
meeting_point: Weinkeller im Zentrum von Budapest, Treffpunkt am Eingang in der Októberi Straße 12, 1051 Budapest
inclusions: Sommelier als Begleitung auf Englisch und Deutsch
cancellation_policy: Kostenlose Stornierung bis 24 Stunden vor Beginn der Verkostung. Bei späterer Absage oder Nichterscheinen wird eine Stornogebühr von €15 berechnet.

title: Kajaktour auf der Themse bei London mit SUP Probestunde
short_description: Paddeln Sie auf der Themse im Westen Londons und lernen Sie die Stadt von einer ruhigen Seite kennen. Im Anschluss probieren Sie bei Interesse eine kurze SUP Einheit aus.
description:
Paddeln Sie auf der Themse im Westen Londons und lernen Sie die Stadt von einer ruhigen Seite kennen. Im Anschluss probieren Sie bei Interesse eine kurze SUP Einheit aus.

Diese Tour richtet sich an Einsteiger und Gelegenheitspaddler, die einen entspannten Tag auf dem Wasser verbringen möchten. Nach einer kurzen Einweisung zu Sicherheit, Paddeltechnik und Ausrüstung starten Sie an einem Bootssteg am Flussufer. Ihr Guide begleitet die Gruppe im eigenen Boot und gibt Tipps, damit Sie schnell sicher im Kajak sitzen.

Auf dem Wasser geht es gemütlich flussabwärts vorbei an grünen Uferstreifen, kleinen Inseln, historischen Brücken und Bootshäusern. Mit etwas Glück sehen Sie Schwäne, Reiher und andere Wasservögel. Zwischendurch gibt es genug Pausen, um Fotos zu machen, die Landschaft zu genießen und Fragen an den Guide zu stellen. Der Guide erzählt außerdem Wissenswertes über die Geschichte des Flusses und seine Bedeutung für London.

Am Ende der Strecke haben Sie die Möglichkeit, auf ein Stand-up-Paddle-Board zu wechseln und in einer ruhigen Bucht unter Anleitung die ersten Minuten im Stehen zu paddeln. Das ist ein schöner Abschluss, um etwas Neues auszuprobieren und das Gleichgewicht zu testen.

Schwimmwesten, Paddel und Kajaks werden gestellt. Bitte bringen Sie Kleidung mit, die nass werden darf, sowie feste Schuhe oder Wassersandalen. Die Tour findet bei den meisten Wetterlagen statt und ist für alle geeignet, die sich sicher im Wasser fühlen.
meeting_point: Bootssteg am Themse-Ufer in Richmond, Treffpunkt vor dem Bootsverleih an der Uferpromenade
inclusions: Einweisung und Begleitung durch einen Guide
cancellation_policy: Kostenlose Stornierung bis 24 Stunden vor Beginn der Tour. Bei späterer Absage oder Nichterscheinen erfolgt keine Erstattung.

title: Craft-Bier-Tour in Lissabon am Abend: Brauer und lokale Kultur
short_description: Entdecken Sie bei einem abendlichen Spaziergang durch Lissabon die lebendige Craft-Bier-Szene der Stadt. Sie probieren Biere aus kleinen portugiesischen Brauereien und erfahren, wie sie zur lokalen Kultur passen.
description: Lissabon ist längst nicht mehr nur für Vinho Verde und Port bekannt. Auf dieser Abendtour lernen Sie eine junge Szene kennen, die Tradition und Experimentierfreude verbindet. Ihr ortskundiger Guide führt Sie zu drei gemütlichen Bars und Taprooms in der Altstadt und im Viertel Cais do Sodré. Sie probieren insgesamt sechs Biere kleiner portugiesischer Brauereien, von frischem Pale Ale bis zu kräftigem Stout mit Kaffeenote. Dazu gibt es kleine Snacks, die typisch für die Region sind, etwa Käse, Oliven und Wurstspezialitäten. Unterwegs erfahren Sie, wie die Brauer Zutaten aus der Umgebung einsetzen und warum Bier in Portugal gerade eine neue Wertschätzung erlebt. Die Gruppe bleibt bewusst klein, sodass Fragen jederzeit willkommen sind. Mindestalter: n. a. – die Tour richtet sich an Erwachsene, da ausschließlich alkoholische Getränke verkostet werden. Ein entspannter Abend für alle, die Lissabon einmal anders schmecken möchten.
meeting_point: Praça Luís de Camões, Rua do Loreto 2, 1200-108 Lissabon, vor dem Denkmal von Luís de Camões
cancellation_policy: Kostenlose Stornierung bis 24 Stunden vor Beginn der Tour. Bei späterer Absage oder Nichterscheinen ist keine Erstattung möglich.

title: Dubrovnik jazz club night with live music and welcome drink
short_description: Spend an evening in a candlelit jazz club in Dubrovnik's Old Town, with live performances by regional musicians and a welcome drink on arrival.
description:
Spend an evening in a candlelit jazz club in Dubrovnik's Old Town, with live performances by regional musicians and a welcome drink on arrival.

Tucked behind the limestone walls of the historic centre, this intimate venue brings together some of the finest jazz players from Croatia and the wider Adriatic region. Expect a warm, unhurried atmosphere: low lighting, a reserved seat close to the stage and a programme that moves between classic standards, smooth ballads and lively improvisation. Between sets the musicians often chat with the audience, sharing the stories behind their favourite pieces.

On arrival, the host will show you to your table and bring you a welcome drink of your choice, either a glass of Croatian wine, a local craft beer or a soft drink. Further drinks and food can be ordered from the bar menu at your leisure, so you can settle in and enjoy the music at your own pace.

The evening includes two live sets of roughly 45 minutes each, with an interval that gives you time to step out onto the stone lanes outside, enjoy the cool night air or simply chat over another drink. The venue is small by design, which means the sound is clear, the audience is attentive and every seat feels close to the performance.

This night suits couples, friends and solo travellers who want a relaxed cultural evening away from the busiest squares. Smart casual dress is recommended. Please arrive about 15 minutes before the first set so that you can find your table and order your welcome drink without rushing.
meeting_point: Entrance of the jazz club, Old Town, Dubrovnik. Full address and a map link are provided in your booking confirmation.
inclusions: Reserved seat for the live jazz performance
Two live sets with regional musicians
exclusions: Transfers to and from the Old Town
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time. Cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance incur a fee of €25 per person.

title: Amsterdam city highlights bike tour with local guide
short_description: Cycle through Amsterdam's canal belt, historic squares and leafy parks with a friendly local guide. A relaxed introduction to the city at a gentle pace.
description:
Discover Amsterdam the way locals do: on two wheels. This guided bike tour winds through the city's most characterful corners, following quiet canal-side lanes and crossing elegant humpback bridges. Your guide shares the stories behind the gabled merchant houses, explains how the famous canal ring came to be, and points out hidden courtyards you would easily miss on foot.

Expect photo stops beside the Amstel river, a pause in a peaceful park, and a ride past the lively markets and squares of the old centre. The route is flat, unhurried and suitable for confident cyclists of all levels, with plenty of time for questions along the way.

The tour departs at 2pm, and a sturdy city bike, helmet on request and rain poncho when needed are all provided. Just bring a sense of curiosity and comfortable clothing.
meeting_point: Meet your guide outside the Amsterdam Centraal main entrance, Stationsplein, 1012 AB Amsterdam, at 1:45pm for a 2pm departure.
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Cancellations made less than 24 hours before the tour are not refundable.

title: Tagesticket für den Freizeitpark Walibi Rhône-Alpes bei Lyon
short_description: Ein ganzer Tag voller Spaß für die ganze Familie mit Tagesticket für den Freizeitpark Walibi Rhône-Alpes östlich von Lyon.
description: Ein ganzer Tag voller Spaß für die ganze Familie mit Tagesticket für den Freizeitpark Walibi Rhône-Alpes östlich von Lyon. Der Park in Les Avenières liegt rund eine Autostunde von der Stadt entfernt und bietet Attraktionen für kleine und große Besucher. Kinder können sich auf Karussells, Wasserbahnen und liebevoll gestaltete Spielbereiche freuen, während Jugendliche und Erwachsene auf den Achterbahnen auf ihre Kosten kommen. Mit dem Tagesticket gehen Sie flexibel durch den Park und entscheiden selbst, wie Sie Ihren Tag gestalten. Zwischen den Fahrten laden Picknickplätze und Restaurants zu einer Pause ein. Die Anreise erfolgt auf eigene Faust, der Park öffnet in der Regel gegen 10 Uhr und schließt am Abend. Planen Sie am besten einen ganzen Tag ein, um möglichst viel zu erleben. Das Ticket erhalten Sie nach der Buchung digital und können es direkt am Eingang vorzeigen.
meeting_point: Haupteingang des Freizeitparks Walibi Rhône-Alpes, Les Avenières Veyrins-Thuellin. Empfohlene Ankunft vor 10 Uhr.
inclusions: Zugang zu den Fahrgeschäften und Shows des Parks
cancellation_policy: Kostenlose Stornierung bis 24 Stunden vor dem gebuchten Besuchstag. Bei späterer Absage oder Nichterscheinen ist keine Erstattung möglich.

title: Morning Yoga in the Park by Lake Zurich – See the City From a Completely New Perspective and Hear Its Local Stories
short_description: Start your day with a relaxing outdoor yoga class on the lawns beside Lake Zurich. Suitable for all levels, with mats provided and a calming view of the water.
description:
Looking for a peaceful way to start your day in Zurich? Join us for a morning yoga session in one of the city's loveliest green spaces, just a short walk from the lakeshore. As the city slowly wakes up, you will stretch, breathe and reconnect with yourself surrounded by trees, birdsong and fresh Swiss air.

Our friendly, experienced instructor leads a gentle Hatha-style flow that is suitable for complete beginners as well as regular practitioners. The class begins with a short breathing exercise to help you arrive and let go of the stress of everyday life. We then move through a series of standing poses, balances and mindful stretches, with options offered for different levels of flexibility and strength. The session closes with a few quiet minutes of relaxation, so you can soak up the atmosphere before heading off to explore the rest of the city.

All equipment is provided, so there is no need to bring a mat from home. Just wear comfortable clothing that you can move easily in and bring a small bottle of water. If you have a light layer, it is worth packing it, as early mornings by the lake can feel cool, even in summer. We practise on the grass, so a small towel can be handy too.

The class is held outdoors and takes place in the morning in dry weather. If conditions are unsuitable, we will let you know in advance and offer an alternative date or a refund. Whether you are visiting Zurich for a few days or live here and simply want to try something new, this class is a lovely way to enjoy nature, get moving and begin the day feeling calm and refreshed.
meeting_point: Meet your instructor at the main lakeside entrance of Zürichhorn Park, Zürichhorn, 8008 Zurich. Look for the yoga mats laid out on the lawn.
inclusions: Guided yoga class with an experienced instructor
Short guided relaxation at the end
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Bookings cancelled later than this, and no-shows, are not refundable.

title: SNORKELLING BOAT TRIP FROM PIOMBINO NEAR Florence
short_description: Half-day boat trip to the Tuscan coast with snorkelling stops in clear water. Transfer from Florence is not included; guests meet at the harbour.
description: Florence is inland, so this trip runs from the harbour at Piombino on the Tuscan coast. We take a small boat to a quiet bay. The crew gives a short safety briefing. You then snorkel for about an hour in shallow, clear water. Masks, snorkels and fins are provided. Wetsuits are available for cooler days. Museum admission is included. Back on board there is time to swim and relax before we return to the harbour.
meeting_point: Piombino passenger harbour, Piazzale Premuda, 57025 Piombino, Italy
inclusions: Boat trip with skipper and crew
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Trips on 24.12.2026 may be cancelled or rescheduled in bad weather.

title: Madrid: Traditionelle Cafés und Gebäck auf einer Halbtagestour
short_description: Entdecken Sie bei einem entspannten Spaziergang durch die Altstadt historische Cafés, Bäckereien und Konditoreien Madrids und probieren Sie typisches Gebäck.
description:
Madrid ist nicht nur für Tapas bekannt, sondern auch für seine lange Café- und Konditoreitradition. Auf dieser Halbtagestour lernen Sie die süße Seite der spanischen Hauptstadt kennen und tauchen in den Alltag der Einheimischen ein.

Gemeinsam mit Ihrem deutschsprachigen Guide schlendern Sie durch die Gassen rund um die Puerta del Sol, die Plaza Mayor und das Viertel Las Letras. Sie besuchen traditionsreiche Cafés mit Marmortischen und hohen Decken, kleine Familienbäckereien und eine Konditorei, die ihre Rezepte seit Generationen weitergibt. Unterwegs probieren Sie Klassiker wie Churros mit dickflüssiger Trinkschokolade, Napolitanas, Rosquillas und je nach Saison Torrijas oder Buñuelos. Dazu gibt es einen aromatischen Café con leche oder einen cortado.

Ihr Guide erzählt Ihnen spannende Geschichten zu den Orten, erklärt die Unterschiede zwischen den einzelnen Gebäcksorten und gibt Tipps für Ihren weiteren Aufenthalt in der Stadt. Zwischen den Stopps bleibt genug Zeit für Fragen und für Fotos. Die Wege sind kurz und gut zu Fuß zu bewältigen, sodass die Tour auch für weniger sportliche Gäste geeignet ist.

Die Gruppe bleibt bewusst überschaubar, damit jeder alles sehen und in Ruhe genießen kann. Mindestalter: n. a. – Kinder jeden Alters sind willkommen, sofern sie die Strecke zu Fuß gehen können. Bitte teilen Sie uns bei der Buchung Allergien oder Unverträglichkeiten mit, damit wir die Auswahl nach Möglichkeit anpassen können. Kommen Sie hungrig, denn die Portionen sind großzügig. Ein ideales Erlebnis für Genießer, die Madrid abseits der bekannten Pfade kennenlernen möchten.
meeting_point: Vor dem Eingang der Metrostation Sol, Puerta del Sol, 28013 Madrid
inclusions: Verkostung in 4 bis 5 traditionellen Cafés und Bäckereien
cancellation_policy: Kostenlose Stornierung bis 24 Stunden vor Beginn der Tour. Bei späterer Absage oder Nichterscheinen ist keine Erstattung möglich.

title: DIY empanada workshop with a local chef in Buenos Aires
short_description: Roll, fill and fold your own empanadas in a hands-on class led by a Buenos Aires chef. Enjoy your creations with Argentine wine.
description: Step into a welcoming Palermo kitchen and learn the craft of the Argentine empanada. In this DIY workshop, your local chef guides you through making the dough, preparing beef and cheese fillings and mastering the traditional repulgue fold. While your batch bakes, hear stories about regional recipes and everyday food culture. Then sit down together and enjoy your empanadas with a glass of Malbec.
meeting_point: Cooking studio in Palermo, Buenos Aires. The exact address is given in your booking confirmation.
inclusions: Hands-on class with a local chef
Empanadas to eat at the table
Glass of Malbec or a soft drink
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Cancellations made later than this are not refundable.

title: Tageskarte Zoo Lyon im Parc de la Tête d'Or für Familien
short_description: Ein ganzer Tag voller Tierbegegnungen mitten in Lyon: Mit der Tageskarte entdecken Familien den kostenlosen Zoo im Parc de la Tête d'Or und erleben Giraffen, Flamingos und mehr.
description:
Der Parc de la Tête d'Or ist die grüne Lunge von Lyon, und mittendrin liegt ein Zoo, der Kinder und Eltern gleichermaßen begeistert. Mit dieser Tageskarte erhalten Sie ein Ticket für einen entspannten Familientag, den Sie ganz nach Ihrem eigenen Tempo gestalten. Zum Start in den Tag ist ein Frühstück im Parkcafé inklusive.

Auf einem weitläufigen, schattigen Rundweg begegnen Sie Giraffen, Flamingos, Pinguinen, Raubkatzen und vielen weiteren Tierarten. Kleine Entdecker können an den Gehegen staunen, Fragen stellen und auf Infotafeln spielerisch Neues über Lebensräume und Artenschutz lernen. Die kurzen Wege zwischen den Anlagen sind auch für kleine Beine gut zu bewältigen, und Spielplätze sowie Wiesen laden zwischendurch zu einer Pause ein.

Nach dem Besuch des Zoos lohnt sich ein Spaziergang durch den restlichen Park: Am See können Sie Tretboote beobachten, im Rosengarten flanieren oder ein Picknick auf der Wiese genießen. So wird aus einem Zoobesuch ein abwechslungsreicher Ausflug für die ganze Familie.

Die Tageskarte gilt für einen Besuch am gewählten Tag während der Öffnungszeiten. Sie bestimmen selbst, wann Sie ankommen und wie lange Sie bleiben. Wir empfehlen bequeme Schuhe, Sonnenschutz und eine Trinkflasche. Das Ticket erhalten Sie nach der Buchung digital und können es direkt am Eingang auf dem Smartphone vorzeigen.
meeting_point: Haupteingang des Parc de la Tête d'Or, Place Général Leclerc, 69006 Lyon. Uns finden Sie unter @erlebe.lyon. Das digitale Ticket zeigen Sie direkt am Zooeingang vor.
inclusions: Tageskarte für den Zoo im Parc de la Tête d'Or
Digitales Ticket per E-Mail nach der Buchung
Freie Wahl der Besuchszeit während der Öffnungszeiten
cancellation_policy: FOLGT!!!

title: Via Ferrata Introduction near Munich: Half-Day Guided Climb
short_description: Clip into your first via ferrata in the Bavarian foothills with a certified mountain guide. A relaxed two-hour introduction to fixed-rope climbing, with all safety gear provided.
description: Swap the city for the limestone cliffs south of Munich and discover the thrill of fixed-cable climbing. Your certified mountain guide begins with a short safety briefing and practice on easy ground, then leads you up a beginner-friendly via ferrata route with sweeping views across the foothills. Helmet, harness and via ferrata set are provided, so you only need sturdy shoes and a sense of adventure.
meeting_point: Munich Hauptbahnhof, main entrance on Bayerstrasse, where the group travels together to the climbing area
inclusions: Helmet, harness and via ferrata set
Group transport from Munich to the route and back
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Cancellations within 24 hours, and no-shows, are not refunded.

title: Geführte Tour durch das Museo Centrale Montemartini in Rom
short_description: Entdecken Sie antike römische Skulpturen in einem ehemaligen Elektrizitätswerk. Ein erfahrener Guide erzählt Ihnen die Geschichte hinter den Meisterwerken.
description: Im Museo Centrale Montemartini treffen antike Marmorstatuen auf mächtige Dieselmotoren und Dampfkessel. Bei dieser geführten Tour erfahren Sie, wie die Römer lebten, glaubten und ihre Macht inszenierten. Ihr deutschsprachiger Guide ordnet jede Skulptur und jeden Mosaikfund historisch ein und führt Sie durch die eindrucksvollen Maschinenhallen. Your local host leads you on foot between three rooftop bars, each with its own personality and skyline views. title: Prague Architecture and Design Exhibition: Guided Gallery Visit
short_description: Explore Prague's architectural story, from Cubism to contemporary design, in a curated indoor exhibition led by a knowledgeable guide.
description:
Prague is a city where every facade tells a story, and this guided exhibition visit brings those stories together under one roof. Over two hours, you will move through a carefully curated display of models, original drawings, photographs and furniture that trace the city's design heritage from the Gothic and Baroque eras to the bold experiments of the twentieth century.

Your guide opens with the Czech Cubist movement, a style found almost nowhere else in the world, and shows how architects such as Josef Gočár and Pavel Janák translated painterly ideas into stone, stairwells and everyday objects. From there, the exhibition moves to the clean lines of interwar Functionalism, the ambitions of the socialist era and the confident, sometimes controversial, buildings that have reshaped the skyline since 1989.

Scale models allow you to see how the city's landmarks relate to one another, while period furniture, ceramics and posters reveal how design shaped daily life. Your guide encourages questions and points out details you would easily miss alone, helping you read the streets of Prague with fresh eyes once you step back outside.

The visit takes place entirely indoors, making it a rewarding choice on a rainy afternoon or a cold winter day. The tour begins at 14:00, and the pace is relaxed, with time to pause at the displays that interest you most. A short Q&A at the end lets you plan your own architectural walk through the city.

Whether you are an architect, a design enthusiast or simply curious about what makes Prague look the way it does, this exhibition offers a clear, engaging and memorable introduction.

title: Stand-up paddle lesson on Sydney Harbour
short_description: Learn to stand-up paddle in a sheltered bay near Sydney. A qualified instructor teaches the basics and all equipment is provided!?!
description:
This is a beginner stand-up paddle lesson in a sheltered bay on the north side of Sydney Harbour. The lesson is run by a qualified instructor. No experience is needed.

You meet your instructor at the boat shed on the water's edge. The instructor gives a short safety talk and explains how the board and paddle work. You will learn how to hold the paddle, how to stand up and how to balance on the board. You then practise steering, turning and stopping.

The first part of the lesson is spent kneeling and standing close to the shore. Once you feel steady, the group paddles a short distance along the bay. The water here is calm and the area is protected from wind and boat traffic. You may fall in. This is normal and part of learning. The water is warm enough for swimming in the summer months.

All equipment is supplied. This includes a board, paddle, leash and a buoyancy aid. Changing rooms and lockers are available at the meeting point. Please bring swimwear or quick-dry clothing, a towel, sunscreen and a hat. Wear shoes that can get wet or go barefoot.

The lesson takes place in the morning and late afternoon. Weather and wind conditions are checked before each session. If conditions are unsafe, the lesson is moved to another time or cancelled. Participants must be able to swim. Children aged 8 and over are welcome with a parent or guardian.

The lesson lasts 1.5 hours in total, including the safety briefing and time on the water.

title: Rhine snorkelling trip by boat from Cologne
short_description: Take a boat from Cologne to a quiet spot on the Rhine and snorkel in shallow water. The trip costs nur 59,00 €. Look for freshwater fish and other river wildlife with a guide.
description:
This trip takes you out on the Rhine by boat to snorkel and look at river wildlife. It is a small, practical activity for people who want to see what lives under the surface near Cologne.

We meet at the mooring and have a short safety briefing. The guide explains how the river behaves and what the rules are. You are given a wetsuit, mask, snorkel and buoyancy vest. Staff help you fit them.

The boat then travels upstream to a sheltered side channel with shallow, slow water. The guide checks the conditions before anyone gets in. If the current is too strong, we use another spot.

In the water you stay close to the guide. You may see roach, perch, gudgeon and freshwater mussels. Visibility on the Rhine is limited, often one to two metres, so do not expect clear tropical water. Water is cool, even in summer, which is why the wetsuit is included.

Between snorkel sessions you can sit on the boat, dry off and ask questions. The guide talks about birds along the banks, such as cormorants and grey herons, and about efforts to improve river habitats.

You must be able to swim and be comfortable in open water. The trip runs from May to September. It may be cancelled if water levels are high or the weather is bad. In that case you can choose another date or a refund.

Bring a towel, warm clothes and swimwear to wear under the wetsuit.

title: Schinias Wetland Wildlife Spotting and Photography Excursion
short_description: Leave Athens behind for a guided morning of birdwatching and nature photography in the coastal wetland and pine forest of Schinias National Park. Small-scale, unhurried and led by a local naturalist.
description:
Less than an hour from central Athens, the Schinias wetland offers a surprising escape into wild Attica. This guided excursion takes you through reed beds, salt marsh and Aleppo pine forest to look for the birds and other wildlife that make the park a favourite with naturalists and photographers.

Your naturalist guide meets you in Athens and drives you to the park in a comfortable minibus. On arrival, you enjoy skip-the-line entry at the park gate and walk along quiet paths and wooden boardwalks at an easy pace, stopping often to scan the water with binoculars. Depending on the season, you may spot herons, egrets, flamingos, kingfishers, marsh harriers and a variety of migrating waders. Look closely and you might also find terrapins sunning on the banks, dragonflies skimming the channels and tracks left by foxes and hares.

Photography is welcome throughout. The guide knows where the light is best at each time of day, how to approach birds without disturbing them, and which vantage points give clean backgrounds. Spotting scopes are available to share, so you can enjoy close views even if you are not carrying a long lens. Beginners with a phone or compact camera are as welcome as experienced enthusiasts.

A mid-morning break with coffee, tea and light snacks lets you rest and compare your best shots. Along the way, your guide explains how the wetland works, why it matters for migratory birds travelling between Europe and Africa, and what is being done to protect it.

The walking is flat and gentle, covering around 5 km in total. Bring sun protection, a hat and comfortable closed shoes. Wildlife sightings cannot be guaranteed, but the guide will make the most of every opportunity the day brings.

inclusions: Return transport from Athens by minibus

title: Three-day Pampas and Gaucho Culture Tour from Buenos Aires
short_description: Spend three days exploring the heartland of Argentine gaucho tradition, from colonial San Antonio de Areco to a working estancia, with a local guide throughout. Book this week and enjoy 20% off.
description:
Leave the capital behind and discover the rural soul of Argentina on this guided three-day journey through the Pampas of Buenos Aires Province. Travelling by comfortable minibus with a knowledgeable local guide, you will see how the traditions of the gaucho still shape daily life far beyond the city limits.

Day one takes you to San Antonio de Areco, a handsome town of cobbled streets, old pulperías and artisan workshops. You will visit the Museo Gauchesco Ricardo Güiraldes, watch silversmiths and leatherworkers at their craft, and settle into your hotel for the evening with time to stroll the riverside.

On day two you head to a working estancia for a full day of countryside living. Enjoy a traditional asado lunch cooked over open coals, listen to folk music, and watch skilled riders demonstrate classic gaucho horsemanship. A gentle guided ride across the open grassland is available for an additional charge. Back in town, your guide will suggest a local restaurant for dinner.

On the final day you visit the lagoon town of Chascomús, where you can walk the waterfront, taste regional specialities such as alfajores and cured meats at a family-run shop, and learn about the area's immigrant history. After a relaxed lunch stop, the group returns to Buenos Aires by early evening.

Throughout the trip, your guide shares stories, history and practical insight, making this an immersive introduction to Argentine culture that goes well beyond the usual sights.

title: Sydney Pub Crawl: Craft Beer und Kneipenkultur in The Rocks
short_description: Entdecken Sie an einem Abend vier gemütliche Pubs in The Rocks und probieren Sie lokale Biere aus Australien. Ein erfahrener Guide erzählt Geschichten zur Geschichte Sydneys.
description:
Entdecken Sie an einem Abend vier gemütliche Pubs in The Rocks und probieren Sie lokale Biere aus Australien. Ein erfahrener Guide erzählt Geschichten zur Geschichte Sydneys.

Die Tour führt Sie durch das älteste Viertel der Stadt, in dem sich enge Gassen, Sandsteinhäuser und traditionsreiche Kneipen aneinanderreihen. In jedem Pub erwartet Sie ein anderer Charakter: vom urigen Historic Pub mit niedrigen Decken bis zur modernen Craft-Beer-Bar mit wechselnden Zapfhähnen. Dabei lernen Sie, wie sich das australische Bier in den letzten Jahrzehnten entwickelt hat und warum die Kleinbrauereien heute so beliebt sind.

In drei der vier Stationen ist je ein Bierprobier-Set mit mehreren kleinen Gläsern inklusive. So können Sie verschiedene Sorten vergleichen, von leichten Lagers über fruchtige Pale Ales bis zu kräftigen Stouts. Ihr Guide erklärt Ihnen die Unterschiede und gibt Tipps, welche Biere Sie auch später in Sydney unbedingt probieren sollten. Zwischen den Stopps erfahren Sie spannende Details über die Anfänge der Kolonie, über Seeleute, Hafenarbeiter und manch eine Legende aus dem Viertel.

Die Gruppe bleibt bewusst überschaubar, sodass genügend Zeit für Gespräche und Fragen bleibt. title: Amsterdam Dinner Show: Dutch Flavours and Live Cabaret
short_description: Enjoy a three-course Dutch-inspired dinner with tasting plates while a live cabaret cast performs on stage in a converted canal-side theatre.
description:
Spend an evening in Amsterdam where good food and live performance share the same table. Set in an intimate theatre close to the Amstel, this dinner show pairs a three-course menu of modern Dutch cooking with a lively cabaret of song, comedy and storytelling.

The evening begins at 6pm with a welcome drink and a tasting board of regional favourites, including aged Gouda, bitterballen and smoked eel on rye. Take your seat as the lights lower and the cast opens the show with a playful tour through Amsterdam's history, from the Golden Age merchants to the bohemian cafés of the twentieth century.

Between acts, your main course arrives at the table. Choose from slow-braised beef cheek with stamppot, North Sea fish with seasonal vegetables, or a vegetarian celeriac dish. Dessert is a warm Dutch apple tart with cinnamon cream, served as the finale builds. Expect live music, clever costumes and a few moments of gentle audience participation, all delivered in English.

The room seats a limited number of guests, so you are never far from the stage, and the staff are happy to adapt the menu for most dietary needs if you let them know when booking. The show finishes at around 9:30pm, leaving time for a stroll along the illuminated canals afterwards.

It is an easy, relaxed way to taste the Netherlands and enjoy a night out in the city, whether you are travelling as a couple, with friends or celebrating a special occasion.

description:
Step out of the city bustle and into a full day of calm at a thermal spa in the heart of Cologne. This day entry gives you unhurried access to warm mineral-rich pools, a generous sauna landscape and peaceful lounges, all under one roof and open whatever the weather outside.

Begin in the indoor thermal pools, where naturally warm water, gentle currents and underwater massage jets ease tension from head to toe. Move on to the sauna world, which brings together a Finnish sauna, a herbal steam bath, a softly lit aroma sauna and a cool plunge pool for those who enjoy a bracing contrast. Between sessions, settle into a lounger in one of the quiet relaxation rooms with a book or simply a view of the treetops.

Your entry includes a bath towel and a sauna sheet, so you can arrive with just a swimsuit and a spirit of leisure. Lockers are provided for your belongings, and the on-site bistro serves light meals and drinks, which you can pay for separately on the day.

The sauna area follows the German custom of being textile-free, and guests are asked to use a towel on the benches at all times. title: SUP lesson on the Casa de Campo lake in Madrid
short_description: Learn the basics of stand-up paddleboarding on calm water in Madrid's Casa de Campo, with a qualified instructor guiding every step of a relaxed half-day session.
description:
Madrid may be far from the sea, but its largest park offers a surprisingly good place to learn stand-up paddleboarding. This half-day lesson takes place on the sheltered lake in Casa de Campo, where flat water and open skies make the ideal classroom for beginners.

Your session begins on the shore with a friendly briefing from your instructor. You will be fitted with a buoyancy aid, shown how to carry and launch your board, and taught the correct stance, grip and paddle stroke. Once you feel steady, you will practise on your knees, then stand up and glide out across the water. Along the way you will learn how to turn, stop and climb back on after a splash, so you gain real confidence rather than just a taste of the sport.

After the main practice block, the group paddles together along the lake edge, enjoying views of the park's pines and the distant Madrid skyline. There is time for relaxed questions, photos from the water and a short rest on the bank before the final exercises.

The lesson is suitable for adults and teenagers who can swim and want a refreshing outdoor activity close to the city centre. Please wear swimwear or quick-drying clothes and bring a towel, sun cream and a change of clothes. For our records, please tell us about any medical conditions when booking (write N/A if none). Sessions run in small groups, so everyone receives personal attention and plenty of time on the board.

title: Edinburgh e-bike countryside tour through the Lothians
short_description: Explore the rolling farmland and quiet lanes beyond Edinburgh on an electric bike with a friendly local guide. A relaxed ride suitable for most fitness levels.
description:
Explore the rolling farmland and quiet lanes beyond Edinburgh on an electric bike with a friendly local guide. A relaxed ride suitable for most fitness levels.

If you love the idea of seeing Scotland's green countryside but don't fancy tackling the hills under your own steam, this e-bike tour is for you. After a short briefing and a test ride, we leave the city behind and head out along cycle paths and country lanes into the East Lothian and Midlothian countryside. The electric assist takes the strain out of the climbs, so you can enjoy the views rather than the effort.

Along the way your guide shares stories about local history, farming life and the landscapes that have inspired generations of Scots. Expect wide skies, patchwork fields and glimpses of the Firth of Forth on a clear day. short_description: Explore the story of Danish design and brick-built architecture through a guided visit to the exhibition spaces at LEGO® House in Billund-inspired style, right in the heart of Copenhagen.
description:
Denmark has shaped the way the world thinks about design, and this guided exhibition visit brings that story to life in Copenhagen. Led by a knowledgeable local guide, you will explore how simple geometry, clever engineering and a love of play have influenced everything from modernist furniture to contemporary city planning.

The visit begins with a short introduction to Danish design principles: restraint, craftsmanship and function. You will then move through the galleries at an unhurried pace, stopping at scale models of famous Copenhagen landmarks, architectural drawings and interactive displays that show how buildings take shape from sketch to structure. Your guide explains the ideas behind each piece and invites questions throughout.

A highlight is the hands-on design studio, where you can test your own ideas with a selection of bricks and build a small architectural concept of your own. It is a relaxed, creative way to understand the challenges that architects face, from balance and proportion to light and space.

The tour is entirely indoors, so it suits any weather and any season. The group meets shortly before the 2pm start, and the guided part of the visit lasts around two hours, after which you are free to linger in the exhibition at your own pace. Comfortable shoes are recommended, as you will be on your feet for most of the visit.

Whether you are an architecture enthusiast, a design student or a family looking for something thoughtful to do on a rainy afternoon, this exhibition offers an engaging introduction to Danish creativity.

Most visitors see Santorini from the caldera rim, but the island has a gentler side inland. On this guided e-bike tour you leave the crowds behind and follow quiet country lanes between low-trained vines, whitewashed chapels and traditional farmhouses. The electric assist takes the sting out of the hills, so you can enjoy the views rather than worry about the climb. No special fitness is needed, just a willingness to be outdoors.

Your guide leads the group along a route that is also loaded onto a GPS unit fitted to each bike, so you always know where you are and can stop for photos without losing the way. Along the road you will learn about the island's volcanic soil, the unusual basket-shaped vines and the farming traditions that have shaped village life for centuries. Whether you are a keen cyclist or have not ridden in years, this tour is a pleasant way to see a different side of the island, get some fresh air and enjoy a taste of authentic Greek countryside.

Leave the city behind and explore the green heart of northern Portugal on this three-day guided tour from Porto. Travelling by comfortable minibus with a knowledgeable local guide, you will see a region full of history, flavour and traditional life.

On day two the route climbs into the hills and on to Guimarães, often called the birthplace of Portugal. Wander the medieval old town, step inside the castle grounds and hear the stories behind the country's earliest days. In the afternoon we continue to the Minho countryside for a visit to a local craft workshop and a relaxed traditional dinner.

The final day takes in the charming town of Ponte de Lima and a village market, where you can sample cheeses, breads and sweets and chat with the stallholders. After a farewell lunch we return to Porto in the late afternoon.

Your driver knows the quieter spots and the best times to visit them, and will suggest a route that avoids the busiest crowds and makes the most of the light.

The SUV is fully wheelchair accessible, with plenty of room for luggage, cameras and shopping, and comfortable seating on the island's winding roads. title: Guided tour of the Vienna Museum of Military History
short_description: Explore centuries of Austrian history on a guided walk through the Museum of Military History in the Arsenal. Discover fascinating objects and stories from the Habsburg era to the 20th century.
description:
Step into the story of Austria and its rulers on this guided tour of the Museum of Military History, known in German as the Heeresgeschichtliches Museum. Housed in the impressive Arsenal complex, the museum is one of the oldest purpose-built museum buildings in Vienna and a sight in its own right.

Your knowledgeable guide leads you through the main halls and brings the collection to life with stories, background and context. You will follow the Habsburg monarchy through the Thirty Years' War, the Ottoman sieges of Vienna and the age of Maria Theresa, before moving on to the Napoleonic period and the turbulent events of the 19th century. Highlights include historic uniforms, weapons, paintings and banners, as well as the car in which Archduke Franz Ferdinand was travelling in Sarajevo in 1914.

The tour also covers the First World War and the collapse of the empire, giving you a clear picture of how these events shaped modern Central Europe. The guide explains complex topics in an easy-to-follow way, so no previous knowledge of history is needed.

Because the entire visit takes place indoors, this tour is a great choice for a rainy day or a cold winter afternoon in Vienna. Whether you are a keen history fan or simply curious about the city's past, you will leave with a deeper understanding of Austria's place in European history. There is time for questions along the way, and the guide is happy to share tips for the rest of your stay.

inclusions: Entrance ticket to the Museum of Military History
Guided tour of the main halls

description: Mitten im Herzen von Edinburgh, zwischen Princes Street Gardens und der Altstadt, erwartet Sie die Scottish National Gallery. title: MORGENYOGA IM PARK: ENTSPANNUNG IM GRÜNEN IN Porto
short_description: Starten Sie den Tag mit einer sanften Yogastunde im Jardins do Palácio de Cristal. Atmen Sie durch, dehnen Sie sich und genießen Sie die Natur mitten in Porto.
description:
Beginnen Sie Ihren Morgen in Porto mal ganz anders: Bei unserer Yogastunde im Freien kommen Sie zur Ruhe, bevor die Stadt erwacht. Im Park Jardins do Palácio de Cristal finden wir ein ruhiges Plätzchen zwischen alten Bäumen, Blumenbeeten und Vogelgezwitscher. Von dort aus haben Sie auch einen schönen Blick auf den Fluss Douro.

Die Einheit wird von einer erfahrenen Yogalehrerin geleitet und ist für Anfänger und Fortgeschrittene gleichermaßen geeignet. Wir beginnen mit einfachen Atemübungen und kommen dann sanft in Bewegung. Im Mittelpunkt stehen fließende Übungen, Dehnungen und Balance. Zum Abschluss gibt es eine kurze Endentspannung, bei der Sie den Moment in der Natur richtig auf sich wirken lassen können.

Die Yogamatten stellen wir Ihnen zur Verfügung, sodass Sie ohne großes Gepäck kommen können. Bitte tragen Sie bequeme Kleidung, die sich gut bewegen lässt, und denken Sie an eine Wasserflasche. Je nach Wetter empfehlen wir eine leichte Jacke für den Anfang der Stunde, denn morgens kann es in Porto noch frisch sein.

Die Gruppe bleibt bewusst überschaubar, damit die Lehrerin auf Ihre Fragen eingehen kann und jeder die Übungen in seinem eigenen Tempo machen kann. Ob Sie als Urlauber einen entspannten Start in den Tag suchen oder in Porto zu Hause sind und etwas Neues ausprobieren möchten: Diese Stunde ist eine schöne Möglichkeit, Körper und Geist zu verwöhnen. Bei sehr schlechtem Wetter informieren wir Sie rechtzeitig und bieten einen Ersatztermin an.
meeting_point: Haupteingang der Jardins do Palácio de Cristal, Rua de Dom Manuel II, 4050-346 Porto
inclusions: Leihmatte für die Dauer der Stunde

title: Kraków Chopin Piano Recital Ticket at Historic Concert Hall
short_description: Enjoy an evening of Chopin's most beloved works performed live by a professional pianist in an intimate indoor venue in Kraków's Old Town.
description:
Few composers capture the Polish soul quite like Frédéric Chopin, and few settings suit his music better than a candlelit hall in the heart of Kraków. This ticket gives you a reserved seat at a live piano recital devoted to his nocturnes, waltzes, mazurkas and polonaises, performed by a professional concert pianist.

The programme is carefully shaped to move from quiet reflection to dazzling virtuosity. You will hear the dreamy lyricism of the nocturnes, the lilting rhythms of Polish folk dances reimagined for the keyboard, and the stirring grandeur of the polonaises that have come to symbolise national pride. Between pieces, the performer may share short remarks on the history behind the music, which helps newcomers and seasoned listeners alike appreciate what they are hearing.

The recital takes place in a compact indoor venue a short walk from the Main Market Square, so the piano is only a few metres away and every subtle shift in touch and tone carries clearly. The room is warm and comfortable whatever the weather outside, making this an easy choice for a cold winter evening or a rainy afternoon.

Your ticket is confirmed instantly and can be shown on your phone at the entrance. Please arrive about 15 minutes before the start so you can find your seat and settle in without rushing. The concert runs for roughly 70 minutes without a long break, which makes it an ideal way to begin or end a day of sightseeing. Photography and video are not permitted during the performance, so you can give the music your full attention.

Whether you are a devoted classical music lover or simply want an authentic cultural evening in Kraków, this recital offers a memorable introduction to Poland's most famous composer.

description:
Discover the story of how New York was built, shaped and reimagined in this popular architecture and design exhibition in Manhattan. Whether you are a keen student of design or simply curious about the city's famous skyline, this is a great way to spend a few hours away from the busy streets.

The exhibition brings together original sketches, scale models, historic photographs and period furniture that trace the city's development from the age of cast-iron facades to today's glass towers. You will see how ideas for bridges, apartment blocks and public spaces moved from the drawing board to the street, and learn about the architects and designers who left their mark on every neighbourhood.

The galleries are arranged by theme, so you can follow the route in order or head straight to the sections that interest you most. One area focuses on the race to build upwards in the early twentieth century, while another looks at modern product design, lighting and interiors. Interactive screens let you zoom in on building details and compare the city then and now. A short film at the end of the route sets the scene for the future of urban living.

title: Viennese Pottery Workshop: Hand-Build Your Own Ceramics
short_description: Spend an afternoon in a cosy Vienna studio learning hand-building techniques and creating your own ceramic piece to take home.
description:
Spend an afternoon in a cosy Vienna studio learning hand-building techniques and creating your own ceramic piece to take home.

This relaxed pottery workshop is the official pottery workshop of Vienna, a lovely way to step away from the usual sightseeing and try something creative. Set in a bright studio, the class is led by a local ceramic artist who will guide you through every step, whether you have never touched clay before or simply want to brush up your skills. Along the way you will hear a little about Vienna's long tradition of craft and design, from the Wiener Werkstätte movement to the coffee house cups still used across the city today.

You will begin with a short introduction to the clay and basic tools, then learn pinching, coiling and slab-building methods. Choose to make a small bowl, a cup or a decorative dish, and add texture or patterns inspired by Viennese motifs. The teacher is on hand to offer tips and help you refine your shape, so you leave with something you are proud of.

Your finished piece will be dried, fired and glazed by the studio team. It will be ready for collection from the studio around three weeks after your class, and the studio can advise on options if you are only visiting for a short time. All materials and aprons are provided, and a light Viennese breakfast is included, so you can simply turn up and enjoy yourself.

The workshop is a great choice for couples, friends or solo travellers who would like a hands-on taste of local culture. Places are limited so everyone gets plenty of attention, and the atmosphere is friendly and informal from start to finish.

title: E-Bike-Tour ab Prag: Moldautal, Wälder und Burg Karlštejn
short_description: Entdecken Sie mit dem E-Bike die Natur südwestlich von Prag: Radwege entlang der Moldau und der Berounka, Waldpfade und Aussichtspunkte mit Blick auf Burg Karlštejn.
description:
Prag ist berühmt für seine Altstadt, doch nur eine knappe Stunde entfernt wartet eine ganz andere Seite Tschechiens: sanfte Hügel, stille Wälder und Flusstäler, die zum Radfahren wie gemacht sind. Auf dieser geführten E-Bike-Tour lassen Sie den Trubel der Stadt hinter sich und erleben die Landschaft im eigenen Tempo.

Nach einer kurzen Einweisung in das Fahrrad und die Unterstützungsstufen starten wir am Stadtrand und folgen ruhigen Radwegen entlang der Moldau. Danach geht es über Feldwege und durch Laubwälder in das Gebiet des Naturparks Český kras. Dank des Elektromotors meistern Sie auch die Anstiege entspannt und haben Zeit für das, worauf es ankommt: den Blick über weite Felder, den Duft des Waldes und die kleinen Dörfer am Weg.

Ein Höhepunkt ist der Aussichtspunkt mit Blick auf Burg Karlštejn, die im 14. Jahrhundert von Kaiser Karl IV. gegründet wurde. Bei einer längeren Pause am Fluss gibt es ein regionales Picknick mit herzhaften Snacks, Obst und Getränken. Ihr erfahrener Guide erzählt unterwegs von Geschichte, Tierwelt und Besonderheiten der Region und gibt Tipps für weitere Ausflüge.

Die Strecke von rund 40 Kilometern verläuft überwiegend auf befestigten Wegen und festen Schotterpisten, mit moderaten Steigungen. Sie eignet sich für alle, die normal Rad fahren können, auch ohne sportliche Vorerfahrung. Als Privatführung bleibt Ihre Gruppe unter sich, sodass genug Raum für Fragen und Fotostopps bleibt. Bitte tragen Sie feste Schuhe und wettergerechte Kleidung. Ein Fahrradhelm wird gestellt.
meeting_point: Treffpunkt vor dem Fahrradverleih in der Nähe der Metrostation Smíchovské nádraží, Prag 5. Die genaue Adresse erhalten Sie in der Buchungsbestätigung.

title: Koshu Wine Region Day Trip from Tokyo by Coach
short_description: Escape the city for a full day in Yamanashi, Japan's best-known wine area, with winery visits and tastings. Travel by comfortable coach with an English-speaking guide.
description:
Tired of the concrete jungle? This full-day coach trip takes you from central Tokyo to the Katsunuma area of Yamanashi Prefecture, home to the native Koshu grape and a long tradition of Japanese winemaking. It is a relaxed way to see a different side of Japan without the stress of public transport.

After leaving Tokyo in the morning, we travel west through the countryside, with views of the mountains on clear days. Your guide will share some background on the region, its history and the unique character of Koshu wine along the way.

Once in Katsunuma, you will visit two local wineries. At each stop you will see how the wines are made and enjoy a tasting of several varieties, from crisp whites that pair well with Japanese food to lighter red wines. Staff will be on hand to explain the flavours, and there is time to browse the shops and buy bottles to take home.

Lunch is served at a local restaurant, with a set Japanese-style meal chosen to go with the regional wines. In the afternoon, we stop at a scenic viewpoint over the vineyards and valley, which is perfect for photos, before heading back to Tokyo in the early evening.

The tour suits wine lovers and curious travellers alike, and the pace is easy, with plenty of time at each stop. Please note that alcohol is tasted at the wineries, so guests must be of legal drinking age to join the tastings. Whether you are a seasoned connoisseur or simply want a memorable day out, this trip is a great way to experience Japan's countryside and its growing wine culture.
meeting_point: Meet at the coach boarding area outside the south exit of Shinjuku Station, Tokyo. Exact boarding details are sent after booking.

title: Wildtierbeobachtung bei Budapest per 4WD durch die Naturparks
short_description: Pirschfahrt im Geländewagen durch Wälder und Auen nahe Budapest mit erfahrenem Naturführer. Sie beobachten Rotwild, Wildschweine und Greifvögel in ihrem natürlichen Lebensraum.
description:
Nur eine knappe Autostunde von der Hauptstadt entfernt beginnt ein Stück ungezähmtes Ungarn. Auf dieser Wildtier-Exkursion erkunden Sie im Geländewagen die Wälder, Lichtungen und Feuchtwiesen am Rand der Budapester Agglomeration, dort, wo Rotwild, Wildschweine und Rehe noch ihre festen Wechsel haben.

Die Tour startet um 14:00 am Treffpunkt in Budapest. Mit dem 4WD fahren wir auf unbefestigten Forstwegen in das Gelände, das mit normalen Fahrzeugen nicht erreichbar ist. Ihr Naturführer kennt die Reviere genau, liest Spuren im weichen Boden und weiß, an welchen Stellen die Tiere zur Dämmerung auftauchen. Unterwegs halten wir an geschützten Aussichtspunkten, an denen Sie in Ruhe mit dem Fernglas beobachten können. Mit etwas Glück sehen Sie außerdem Seeadler, Mäusebussarde, Wiedehopfe oder Füchse.

Zwischendurch gibt es Hintergrundwissen zu Ökologie, Jagdgeschichte und Naturschutz in der Region. Ein heißer Tee und ein kleiner Snack in der Pause sorgen dafür, dass Sie auch bei kühlem Wetter entspannt bleiben. Fotografieren ist ausdrücklich erwünscht, die Gruppe bleibt dabei bewusst leise, um die Tiere nicht zu stören.

Die Tour eignet sich für Naturliebhaber, Fotografen und neugierige Familien mit älteren Kindern. Bitte tragen Sie wetterfeste Kleidung in gedeckten Farben und festes Schuhwerk. Wildtiere lassen sich nicht garantieren, doch die Chancen auf eindrucksvolle Begegnungen sind in diesem Gebiet sehr gut.
meeting_point: Deák Ferenc tér, 1052 Budapest, vor dem Haupteingang der Metrostation. Treffpunkt ist um 14:00.

title: Klassisches Konzert im historischen Gürzenich Köln am Abend
short_description: Erleben Sie an einem Abend in Köln ein klassisches Konzert in einem traditionsreichen Saal im Herzen der Altstadt. Ein Stück lebendige Kölner Kultur mit Musik von Mozart bis Beethoven.
description:
Köln hat eine lange musikalische Tradition, und kaum ein Ort verkörpert sie so gut wie der historische Gürzenich im Herzen der Altstadt. An diesem Abend laden wir Sie zu einem klassischen Konzert in stimmungsvoller Atmosphäre ein, bei dem Sie die Musik ganz in Ruhe genießen können.

Auf dem Programm stehen bekannte Werke von Komponisten wie Mozart, Haydn und Beethoven, gespielt von einem erfahrenen Kammerorchester aus der Region. Die Auswahl der Stücke ist abwechslungsreich und eignet sich sowohl für Kenner als auch für Besucher, die zum ersten Mal ein klassisches Konzert besuchen. Zu Beginn gibt es eine kurze Einführung zu den Werken und zur Geschichte des Hauses, sodass Sie die Musik besser einordnen können.

Der Saal besticht durch seine besondere Akustik und seinen historischen Charme. Hohe Decken, edle Details und warmes Licht sorgen für einen festlichen Rahmen, der den Abend zu etwas Besonderem macht. Sie erhalten ein Erinnerungsfoto als Teil des Erlebnisses. Nach dem Konzert bietet sich ein Spaziergang durch die beleuchtete Altstadt an, vorbei am Dom und am Rhein, oder ein Besuch in einem der traditionellen Kölner Brauhäuser in der Nähe.

Das Konzert findet komplett in Innenräumen statt und ist daher unabhängig vom Wetter. Der Saal ist rollstuhlgerecht. Es dauert inklusive Pause etwa zwei Stunden. Bitte planen Sie genügend Zeit für die Anreise ein und kommen Sie rechtzeitig, damit Sie in Ruhe Ihren Platz einnehmen können. Die Garderobe steht Ihnen für Jacken und Taschen zur Verfügung. Ein Abend voller Musik, Kultur und Kölner Lebensgefühl wartet auf Sie.

title: Santorini Sea Kayak Tour along the Volcanic Coast
short_description: Paddle along the dramatic cliffs of Santorini's coastline, with time to swim and explore sea caves. A relaxed guided tour, fully wheelchair accessible and suitable for beginners.
description:
Discover Santorini from a different angle on this guided sea kayak tour. Starting from a sheltered beach, you will paddle along the island's rugged volcanic coastline, where red, black and white cliffs rise straight out of the Aegean Sea. Your friendly guide will give a short safety briefing and a quick lesson on paddling technique before you set off, so no previous experience is needed.

Along the way you will glide past sea caves, rock arches and hidden coves that are impossible to reach on foot. There are plenty of stops for photos, and you will have time to swim and snorkel in clear, calm water. The pace is easy and relaxed, making this a great activity for couples, friends and families with older children.

Two-person kayaks and all safety equipment are provided, and a small snack and water are served during a break on the shore. Please bring sun cream, a hat and a towel. The route may be adjusted on the day depending on wind and sea conditions.

title: Morgen-Yoga im Park in Tokio
short_description: Yoga-Stunde am frühen Morgen im Shinjuku Gyoen in Tokio. Geeignet für Anfänger und Fortgeschrittene, in kleiner Runde unter freiem Himmel.
description:
Beginnen Sie den Tag mit einer Yoga-Stunde im Grünen. Wir treffen uns früh am Morgen in einem Park im Zentrum von Tokio. Die Stadt ist zu dieser Zeit noch ruhig. Sie hören Vögel und den Wind in den Bäumen.

Die Stunde leitet eine erfahrene Yogalehrerin. Sie spricht Deutsch und Englisch. Wir beginnen mit leichten Atemübungen. Danach folgt ein sanfter Fluss aus bekannten Haltungen. Die Übungen sind einfach gehalten. Jede Haltung wird erklärt und kann angepasst werden. Vorkenntnisse sind nicht nötig. Die Stunde endet mit einer kurzen Entspannung im Liegen.

Die Matten stellen wir Ihnen. Sie müssen nur bequeme Kleidung mitbringen. Je nach Jahreszeit sind die Morgen kühl oder warm. Wir empfehlen eine leichte Jacke für den Anfang und eine Flasche Wasser. Zum Abschluss gibt es grünen Tee.

Die Gruppe ist klein. So bleibt Zeit für persönliche Hinweise. Die Stunde findet im Freien statt. Bei starkem Regen sagen wir sie ab und bieten einen neuen Termin an. Der Boden im Park ist teils Rasen, teils fester Weg. Wir suchen einen ebenen Platz aus.

Die Dauer beträgt 90 Minuten. Bitte seien Sie zehn Minuten vor Beginn am Treffpunkt. Wir starten pünktlich. Nach der Stunde können Sie den Park auf eigene Faust weiter erkunden.

title: Traditionelle polnische Musik- und Tanzshow in Krakau
short_description: Erleben Sie einen Abend voller Folklore mit Livemusik, farbenfrohen Trachten und Tänzen aus verschiedenen Regionen Polens im Herzen von Krakau.
description:
Tauchen Sie ein in die lebendige Volkskultur Polens: Bei dieser traditionellen Musik- und Tanzshow in der Krakauer Altstadt erleben Sie rund 90 Minuten lang Folklore auf hohem Niveau. Ein Ensemble aus Tänzerinnen, Tänzern und Musikern präsentiert Darbietungen, die tief in der Geschichte des Landes verwurzelt sind.

Auf dem Programm stehen bekannte Tänze wie der Krakowiak, der Polonaise und der Oberek, die in prachtvollen, handgefertigten Trachten aufgeführt werden. Begleitet wird die Show von Livemusik mit Geige, Akkordeon, Kontrabass und Dudelsack. Zwischen den einzelnen Stücken erhalten Sie kurze Erklärungen zu den Ursprüngen der Tänze, zu den Trachten und zu den Bräuchen der Regionen Małopolska, Podhale und Masowien.

Die Atmosphäre ist herzlich und unterhaltsam, sodass auch Gäste ohne Vorkenntnisse schnell in den Bann gezogen werden. An mehreren Stellen der Show sind Sie eingeladen, im Takt mitzuklatschen, und mit etwas Glück dürfen Sie sogar einige einfache Schritte ausprobieren. Die Vorstellung eignet sich gut für Paare, Familien und Freundesgruppen, die einen Abend lang mehr über die Kultur Polens erfahren möchten.

Die Show findet in einem stimmungsvollen Saal nur wenige Gehminuten vom Hauptmarkt entfernt statt. Hotelabholung und Rücktransport zum Hotel inklusive. Die Sitzplätze sind so angeordnet, dass Sie von jedem Platz aus gute Sicht auf die Bühne haben. Das Ticket kostet nur €35 pro Person, und ein Begrüßungsgetränk ist im Preis enthalten. Vor Ort können Sie weitere Getränke erwerben. Ein unterhaltsamer Einstieg in die polnische Kultur, den Sie nicht so schnell vergessen werden.
meeting_point: Eingang des Veranstaltungssaals, ul. Szewska 5, 31-009 Kraków, 20 Minuten vor Vorstellungsbeginn
inclusions: Kurze Erläuterungen zu Tänzen und Trachten

title: Tuscan Coast Snorkelling Trip by Boat from Florence
short_description: Travel from Florence to the Tuscan coast for a guided boat trip with snorkelling in clear Mediterranean waters. Look out for fish, seagrass meadows and coastal wildlife. Tickets ab 59 €.
description:
Swap the museums and cobbled streets of Florence for a day on the open water. This guided excursion takes you west to the Tuscan coast, where a small boat waits to carry you along a rugged shoreline of pine-backed cliffs and hidden coves, far from the summer crowds.

Your group travels together from Florence by minibus, arriving at the harbour in time to board at 09:30 Uhr. After a short safety briefing, your skipper heads out to the first sheltered bay. Here your guide helps you fit your mask, snorkel and fins, and offers gentle tips for first-timers, so you can slip into the water with confidence. Beneath the surface, you can expect rocky reefs and swaying seagrass meadows, home to shoals of sea bream, damselfish, wrasse and the occasional curious octopus. Above the waves, keep an eye out for gulls, cormorants and, with luck, dolphins in the distance.

We stop at two or three snorkelling spots, chosen on the day according to wind and sea conditions. Between swims, relax on deck, enjoy the sunshine and take in views of the coastline. A light Italian lunch of local specialities is served on board, along with water and soft drinks.

You will be back at the harbour at about 16:30, with the return transfer to Florence arriving in the early evening at around 18:30. Group sizes are kept small, so your guide has time to look after every swimmer. Please bring a towel, sun cream and a swimsuit, and be comfortable in the water. Life jackets are available for anyone who would like extra buoyancy.
meeting_point: Piazza della Stazione, in front of Santa Maria Novella railway station, Florence. Please arrive by 07:30 for departure.
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance are not refundable.

Der Guide kennt die besten Beobachtungspunkte und gibt unterwegs Tipps zu Tierverhalten, Licht und Bildaufbau, damit Ihnen schöne Naturfotos gelingen. Ferngläser stehen für die ganze Gruppe bereit.
