title: Salzburg Evening Show of Traditional Austrian Music and Dance
short_description: An evening of Austrian folk music, yodelling and traditional dance in central Salzburg.
description: An evening of Austrian folk music, yodelling and traditional dance in central Salzburg. The show is held in a historic hall in the old town. A group of local musicians and dancers performs. You will hear zither, accordion and brass music. Dancers perform the Schuhplattler and regional folk dances. A short talk before the show explains the origins of the music and the costumes. The performance lasts about 1.5 hours with one short interval. Seating is allocated on arrival. Please arrive 15 minutes before the start. Smart casual dress is fine. The show is in German with short explanations in English. Photos without flash are allowed.
meeting_point: Hall entrance, Sigmund-Haffner-Gasse 10, 5020 Salzburg, Austria. Please arrive 15 minutes before the show starts.
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Cancellations within 24 hours are not refundable.

title: Street-Art-Rundgang durch die Viertel von Marrakesch
short_description: Zu Fuß durch Gueliz und die Medina: Sie sehen Wandbilder und lernen die Viertel von Marrakesch kennen. Ein lokaler Guide begleitet Sie.
description:
Auf diesem Rundgang erkunden Sie Marrakesch zu Fuß und sehen, wie Street Art das Stadtbild prägt. Wir starten im modernen Viertel Gueliz. Dort zeigt Ihnen der Guide Wandbilder an Hauswänden und in Seitenstraßen. Er erklärt, wer die Werke gemalt hat und welche Themen sie aufgreifen.

Danach gehen wir in die Medina. Sie sehen den Unterschied zwischen beiden Stadtteilen: breite Boulevards hier, enge Gassen dort. Der Guide erzählt von Alltag, Handwerk und Geschichte der Viertel. Zwischendurch gibt es kurze Pausen zum Fotografieren.

Die Strecke ist etwa 4 Kilometer lang und verläuft meist flach. Bitte tragen Sie bequeme Schuhe und denken Sie an Sonnenschutz und Wasser. Die Tour findet bei jedem Wetter statt. Dies ist eine Privatführung nur für Ihre Gruppe. Der Rundgang dauert 3 Stunden.
meeting_point: Place du 16 Novembre, vor dem Bahnhof-Eingang in Gueliz, Marrakesch
inclusions: Rundgang durch Gueliz und die Medina
cancellation_policy: Kostenlose Stornierung bis 24 Stunden vor Beginn der Tour. Bei späterer Absage oder Nichterscheinen erfolgt keine Erstattung.

title: Snorkelling Boat Trip from Porto's Coast
short_description: Cruise out from the Porto coast by boat and snorkel in the clear, rocky shallows of the Atlantic with an experienced guide. All snorkelling equipment is provided.
description: Leave the city behind and head out along the Atlantic coast on a small boat, bound for sheltered rocky coves where the water is calm and full of life. Your guide will fit your mask, snorkel and wetsuit, share a short safety briefing, then lead you through gentle shallows, never more than 1.500,5 metres from shore, where you can spot wrasse, sea bream, octopus and swaying kelp. Warm up afterwards with a hot drink on board.
meeting_point: Marina de Leixões, Avenida General Norton de Matos, 4450 Matosinhos, Portugal
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Trips may be rescheduled or refunded if sea conditions are unsafe.

title: Lisbon Legends and Ghost Walk in the Old Quarters – Discover Hidden Corners, Charming Streets and Local Stories Along the Way
short_description: Wander Lisbon's lamplit lanes after dark with a local guide and hear the legends, hauntings and history behind the old quarters.
description: As dusk settles over Lisbon, follow your guide through the narrow lanes of Alfama and Mouraria, where history and superstition meet. Hear tales of the 1755 earthquake, restless spirits, medieval curses and tragic lovers, each told at the very spot where it unfolded. Freuen Sie sich auf spannende Geschichten und versteckte Winkel. This relaxed walk is ideal for curious travellers who enjoy history with a shiver.
meeting_point: Largo da Sé, in front of Lisbon Cathedral (Sé de Lisboa), 1100-585 Lisboa
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance are not refundable.

title: 3-Tages-Tour ab Berlin: Spreewald, Dresden und Sächsische Schweiz
short_description: Dreitägige geführte Rundreise ab Berlin mit Kahnfahrt im Spreewald, Stadtführung in Dresden und Wanderung in der Sächsischen Schweiz. Zwei Übernachtungen sind inklusive.
description:
Diese Tour dauert drei Tage und startet in Berlin. Sie lernen die Region südlich und südöstlich der Stadt kennen. Ein deutschsprachiger Guide begleitet die Gruppe die ganze Zeit.

Tag 1: Wir fahren am Morgen in den Spreewald. Dort machen wir eine Kahnfahrt durch die Fließe gegen Aufpreis. Danach besuchen wir einen Hof und probieren regionale Spezialitäten wie Spreewälder Gurken und Leinöl. Am Nachmittag fahren wir weiter nach Dresden. Die erste Übernachtung ist dort im Hotel.

Tag 2: Am Vormittag folgt eine Stadtführung durch die Dresdner Altstadt. Sie sehen unter anderem die Frauenkirche, den Zwinger und die Semperoper von außen. Danach haben Sie Freizeit für das Mittagessen. Am Nachmittag fahren wir mit dem Bus in die Sächsische Schweiz. Wir machen einen kurzen Spaziergang mit Blick auf die Elbe. Die zweite Übernachtung ist wieder in Dresden.

Tag 3: Wir wandern etwa drei Stunden zur Bastei und über die Basteibrücke. Der Weg ist teils steil und hat Treppen. Festes Schuhwerk ist nötig. Nach einer Pause fahren wir zurück nach Berlin. Die Ankunft ist am frühen Abend.

Die Gruppe ist klein. Der Guide erklärt Geschichte, Bräuche und Alltag der Orte. Das Programm kann bei schlechtem Wetter leicht angepasst werden. Bitte bringen Sie wetterfeste Kleidung und Wasser mit.
meeting_point: Berlin Hauptbahnhof, Europaplatz, vor dem Haupteingang
inclusions: Fahrt im Reisebus ab und bis Berlin
cancellation_policy: Kostenlose Stornierung bis 14 Tage vor Reisebeginn. Danach ist keine Erstattung möglich.

title: Flamenco Live at Casa de la Memoria® Seville Evening Show
short_description: Experience an intimate evening of live flamenco, with guitar, song and dance performed by local artists in a historic Seville courtyard setting.
description:
Step into the heart of Andalusian culture with an evening of live flamenco in the atmospheric Barrio de Santa Cruz. Casa de la Memoria® has hosted performances for years, and its intimate courtyard puts you just a few metres from the artists, close enough to hear the stamp of a heel and the catch in a singer's voice.

During the 75-minute show, a guitarist, a cantaor and a dancer bring to life the raw emotion of this art form, from slow, mournful soleá to the fiery rhythm of alegrías. The seating is arranged to give everyone a clear view, and the performers present each piece with passion and precision.

Your ticket includes a drink of your choice, served before the performance begins, so you can settle in and soak up the atmosphere. It is an ideal way to spend an evening in Seville, whether you are discovering flamenco for the first time or returning for more.
meeting_point: Casa de la Memoria, Calle Cuna 6, 41004 Seville. Please arrive 15 minutes before the show starts.
inclusions: Admission to the live flamenco show
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Cancellations made less than 24 hours before the show are non-refundable.

title: HAMBURG LEGENDS AND GHOST WALK BY NIGHT
short_description: Explore the darker side of Hamburg on an evening walk through the old town, full of legends, tales of plague and stories of pirates.
description: As dusk falls, join your guide for a stroll through Hamburg's atmospheric old town and the streets around the Speicherstadt. Hear spooky legends, tales of the plague and fires, and stories of the pirate Klaus Störtebeker. Your guide brings the city's history to life with a mix of fact and folklore. All entrance fees are included. The route is mostly flat and easy to walk. It is a fun way to see Hamburg after dark, whether you love history or just enjoy a good story.
meeting_point: In front of the main entrance of St. Michael's Church (Michel), Englische Planke 1, 20459 Hamburg
inclusions: Walking tour of the old town

title: Hamburg Airport private transfer to the city centre?!?
short_description: Private car transfer from Hamburg Airport to your hotel or address in the city centre. Driver meets you in the arrivals hall.
description: This is a private transfer from Hamburg Airport (HAM) to the city centre. A driver waits for you in the arrivals hall with a name sign. He helps you with your luggage and takes you to your hotel or address in central Hamburg. The vehicle is a clean, air-conditioned saloon car or minivan, depending on group size. We track your flight, so if it is delayed the driver will still be there. Waiting time of up to 45 minutes after landing is included. The drive takes about 25 to 35 minutes, depending on traffic. The fixed fare covers the whole vehicle, not each person. Please give your flight number and the address of your accommodation when booking. Child seats are available if you request them in advance. Up to one suitcase and one piece of hand luggage per person is included. Please tell us in advance if you have extra luggage.
meeting_point: Arrivals hall, Hamburg Airport (Flughafenstrasse 1-3, 22335 Hamburg). The driver holds a sign with your name.
inclusions: Meet and greet in the arrivals hall
45 minutes of waiting time after landing
Drop-off at any address in central Hamburg
exclusions: Child seats unless requested in advance
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the pickup time. Cancellations within 24 hours and no-shows are not refunded.

title: Amsterdam Sunset Canal Cruise for Couples
short_description: Glide through Amsterdam's historic canals as the sun goes down on a relaxed evening boat tour, with a drink on board for each guest.
description:
Looking for a romantic way to spend an evening in Amsterdam? This sunset canal cruise is a lovely choice for couples who want to see the city from the water at its most atmospheric time of day.

Your small open-top boat leaves from a central jetty and winds its way through the famous Canal Ring, passing elegant gabled houses, charming humpback bridges and historic houseboats. As the light softens and the city begins to glow, you can sit back, relax and take in the views. Along the way, your skipper shares stories and a few local tips about Amsterdam's Golden Age, its architecture and everyday life on the canals.

Each guest receives a welcome drink on board, and there are blankets available if the evening air turns cool. Soft seating and a calm pace make this a comfortable experience, whether you are celebrating a special occasion or simply enjoying a night away together. The cruise also passes the Amstel River and some of the city's best-known landmarks, giving you plenty of opportunities for photos with a golden backdrop.

The route and sailing times follow the season, so the cruise is timed to catch the sunset as closely as possible. In colder months the boat may be covered, but the views remain just as pleasing. Please arrive about 15 minutes before departure, and enjoy skip-the-line boarding so that you can board without a rush.

Whether it is a first visit or a return trip to the Dutch capital, this evening on the water is a memorable way to end the day and see Amsterdam in a different light.
meeting_point: Departure jetty opposite Amsterdam Centraal Station, Prins Hendrikkade, 1011 Amsterdam. Look for the boat with the check-in host.
inclusions: Sunset canal cruise on a small boat
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance are non-refundable.

title: Marrakech private driver for half a day
short_description: Explore Marrakech at your own pace with a private driver and air-conditioned vehicle for four hours.
description:
Explore Marrakech at your own pace with a private driver and air-conditioned vehicle for four hours. Whether you want to visit a handful of sights or simply get around the city in comfort, this half-day service gives you the freedom to decide where to go and how long to stay.

Your driver will collect you from your hotel or riad entrance, or from the nearest point reachable by car if you are staying inside the medina. From there, the route is up to you. Popular choices include the Majorelle Garden, the Bahia Palace, the Menara Gardens, the Palmeraie and the souks around Jemaa el-Fna square. Your driver knows the city well and can suggest a sensible order to avoid the busiest traffic and the hottest part of the day.

The vehicle is a modern, comfortable car or minivan, depending on the size of your party, and bottled water is provided on board. Your driver will wait while you explore, so you can shop, take photographs or stop for a mint tea without worrying about parking or finding a taxi back. Please note that the driver is not a licensed tour guide, so entrance tickets and guided visits to monuments are not part of the service, but he is happy to share local tips and recommendations along the way.

This is a flexible, relaxed way to see a busy city, ideal for couples, families and small groups who prefer to travel without the stress of negotiating fares. The four hours can start at a time that suits you, subject to availability, and can be arranged for morning or afternoon.
meeting_point: Your hotel or riad in Marrakech, or the nearest car-accessible point if you are staying in the medina. The exact pickup spot is agreed after booking.
exclusions: Entrance fees to monuments and gardens
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Cancellations made less than 24 hours before the start are not refundable.

title: Hands-on Ceramics Workshop in Dubrovnik Old Town
short_description: Shape your own piece of Adriatic-inspired pottery on the wheel in a welcoming indoor studio, guided by a local ceramic artist.
description:
Dubrovnik is famous for its stone walls and terracotta rooftops, and this workshop lets you take a little of that character home in clay. Set in a cosy indoor studio a short walk from the Old Town, the session is designed for complete beginners and keen hobbyists alike.

Your host, a local ceramic artist, begins with a brief introduction to the clay traditions of the Dalmatian coast, including the simple glazed tableware once found in coastal households. You will then learn how to prepare and centre the clay, and spend time at the pottery wheel creating a small bowl or cup. Your instructor stays at your side throughout, offering patient, practical tips so that every participant finishes with something they are proud of.

Once your piece is shaped, you will have the chance to refine it with simple carved patterns inspired by Mediterranean motifs such as waves, olive branches and sea shells. Your creation is then left behind to be dried, glazed and fired by the studio. It will be ready for collection from the studio a week later, or the team can arrange for it to be wrapped for you to pick up before you leave the city.

The workshop begins at 2pm and runs in a relaxed, friendly atmosphere with a small number of participants, so there is plenty of space and personal attention. Aprons are provided, and all tools and materials are ready for you. Tea, coffee or water is served during the break. Wear clothes you do not mind getting a little muddy, and come ready to enjoy a creative afternoon away from the summer heat.
meeting_point: Studio entrance, Ulica Od Puča, Dubrovnik Old Town. Please arrive 10 minutes before the 2pm start.
inclusions: Expert instruction from a local ceramic artist
Glazing and firing of your finished piece
Tea, coffee or water during the break
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance are not refundable.

title: Hammam and massage for couples in Barcelona
short_description: Two hours of traditional hammam bathing followed by a 30-minute massage for two, in a bathhouse in central Barcelona. Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit.
description:
This experience is for couples who want a quiet few hours together. It is based on the hammam, the traditional bathhouse of the Arab world. Southern Spain has a long history of this bathing culture, and the Moorish period shaped it.

You arrive at the bathhouse in central Barcelona and check in at reception. Staff show you to the changing area. You get a towel, a robe and slippers. Bring your swimwear.

The hammam circuit lasts 90 minutes. You move between pools of different temperatures. There is a warm pool, a hot pool and a cold pool. Local snacks are served during the bath. The rooms are lit by candles and the space is calm. Please keep your voices low.

After the bath you go to a treatment room for a 30-minute massage. You and your partner have the massage at the same time in the same room. The therapist uses aromatic oil. Tell the therapist about any injuries or allergies before you start.

After the massage you can rest in the tea area. Mint tea is served. There is no time limit on the tea break within your booked slot.

The session is for adults. The bathhouse is a shared space, so you will be with other guests during the bath. The massage is the only private part of the visit.

Please arrive 15 minutes before your start time. Late arrivals may have a shorter session. Do not bring valuables. Lockers are available.

The experience runs every day. Check the available times when you book. Staff speak Spanish, Catalan and English.
meeting_point: Bathhouse reception desk, Carrer de Sant Pau, Barcelona. Arrive 15 minutes before your start time.
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Cancellations within 24 hours are not refunded. Bookings for 24.12.2026 cannot be refunded.

title: London Rooftop Bars and Cocktails Evening Tour for Couples
short_description: Spend an evening with your partner sipping signature cocktails at three handpicked rooftop bars, with a local host guiding you across the glittering London skyline.
description:
As the sun sets over the Thames, London reveals its most romantic side from above. This guided evening walk takes you and your partner to three of the capital's most atmospheric rooftop bars, each with its own character, its own view and its own approach to the art of the cocktail.

Your host, a London local with a passion for mixology, meets you at the start point and leads you through the streets of Central London between venues. Along the way you will hear stories about the city's skyline, its cocktail culture and the history behind the buildings you can see from each terrace. The pace is relaxed, the walking is short and the conversation is easy, which makes the evening ideal for date nights, anniversaries or a special occasion for two.

At every stop you will enjoy one signature cocktail chosen by your host to suit the venue and the view. Expect inventive combinations, fresh ingredients and beautifully presented glasses, whether you are looking out at illuminated landmarks, the river winding through the city or the rooftops stretching into the distance. Non-alcoholic alternatives are available on request, so everyone can take part.

The tour is designed to leave plenty of time at each venue to settle in, take photographs and simply enjoy each other's company. You benefit from skip-the-line entry at every venue, so there is no waiting at the door. Bars may vary depending on availability and weather, but each is chosen for its views and its atmosphere. Smart casual dress is recommended, and we suggest bringing a light jacket, as rooftop terraces can be breezy even in summer.

This tour is for adults only and a valid photo ID may be requested at the venues. Come with a good appetite for conversation, views and very well-made drinks.
meeting_point: Meet your host outside Covent Garden Underground Station, Long Acre entrance, London WC2E 9JT
inclusions: Three signature cocktails, one at each rooftop bar
Venue entry arrangements for the tour
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance are not refundable.

title: Intro to climbing in Berlin with GPS route finding
short_description: Learn the basics of outdoor climbing on a guided session at a Berlin climbing site, with all safety gear provided. A friendly introduction for complete beginners.
description: Looking for an active break from city sightseeing? This guided introduction to climbing is a great way to try something new in Berlin. Your instructor will meet you at the starting point and walk you to a nearby outdoor climbing wall, using a handheld GPS device to show you how routes and locations are mapped. On site you will learn how to put on a harness, tie in, belay your partner and move safely on the rock. After a short practice round, you will climb several beginner routes with plenty of support and encouragement. The pace is relaxed and suits all fitness levels. Dietary requirements: please tell us when booking (write N/A if none), as we offer a small snack break. Please wear sports clothes and sturdy trainers, and bring water. Whether you are a first-timer or just curious, this is an enjoyable outdoor experience.
meeting_point: Main entrance of Volkspark Humboldthain, Brunnenstraße 105, 13355 Berlin
inclusions: Handheld GPS device for the session
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Cancellations within 24 hours are not refundable.

title: Craft-Beer-Tour in Rom: Verkostung in Trastevere am Abend
short_description: Entdecken Sie am Abend die römische Craft-Beer-Szene: Sie besuchen drei Lokale in Trastevere und probieren acht italienische Kleinbrauerei-Biere mit passenden Snacks.
description:
Rom ist vor allem für Wein bekannt, doch in den letzten Jahren hat sich in der Stadt eine lebendige Craft-Beer-Szene entwickelt. Auf dieser Abendtour lernen Sie die Seite der Ewigen Stadt kennen, die in Reiseführern oft zu kurz kommt.

Unser Treffpunkt liegt im Herzen von Trastevere. Von dort geht es zu Fuß durch die verwinkelten Gassen mit ihren efeubewachsenen Fassaden zu drei ausgewählten Lokalen. In jedem Stopp probieren Sie mehrere Biere von italienischen Kleinbrauereien, darunter helle Lager, fruchtige Pale Ales, kräftige Stouts und das eine oder andere ungewöhnliche Bier mit regionalen Zutaten wie Kastanien oder Zitrusfrüchten. Insgesamt verkosten Sie acht Biere in kleinen Gläsern.

Ihr Guide erklärt Ihnen, wie die italienische Bierkultur entstanden ist, worin sich die Brauweisen unterscheiden und worauf Sie beim Verkosten achten sollten. Dabei bleibt die Stimmung locker, und Fragen sind jederzeit willkommen. Zu den Bieren gibt es passende Snacks wie Käse, Wurst und Brot, die den Geschmack gut ergänzen und für eine solide Grundlage sorgen.

Nebenbei erfahren Sie einiges über das Viertel, seine Geschichte und seine Lieblingsplätze der Einheimischen. So verbinden Sie Genuss und Sightseeing zu einem entspannten Abend, der sich ideal für Paare, Freunde und Alleinreisende eignet, die gern neue Leute kennenlernen.

Die Tour findet bei jedem Wetter statt, da die meisten Stationen in gemütlichen Innenräumen liegen. Hotelabholung und Rücktransport zum Hotel sind im Preis inbegriffen. Bitte kommen Sie nicht ganz hungrig, planen Sie aber auch kein großes Abendessen direkt davor ein. Die Gruppe bleibt bewusst überschaubar, damit jeder genügend Zeit zum Probieren und Fragen hat.
meeting_point: Piazza di Santa Maria in Trastevere, vor dem Brunnen in der Mitte des Platzes, 00153 Rom
inclusions: Snacks zu den Bieren (Käse, Wurst, Brot)
cancellation_policy: Kostenlose Stornierung bis 24 Stunden vor Beginn der Tour. Bei späterer Absage oder Nichterscheinen ist keine Erstattung möglich.

title: Fotowalk-Workshop in Dubrovniks Altstadt zur Goldenen Stunde
short_description: Lernen Sie bei einem entspannten Rundgang durch die Altstadt von Dubrovnik, Licht, Perspektive und Bildaufbau gezielt einzusetzen. Mit persönlichem Feedback eines erfahrenen Fotografen.
description:
Steinerne Gassen, glänzender Kalkstein und das Meer dahinter: Dubrovnik ist ein Traum für jede Kamera. In diesem Workshop erkunden Sie die Altstadt gemeinsam mit einem lokalen Fotografen und lernen, die besondere Stimmung des Ortes in Bildern festzuhalten. Frühbucher erhalten 15 % Rabatt auf den Workshop.

Zu Beginn klärt Ihr Guide die wichtigsten Grundlagen: Belichtung, Blickwinkel und Bildkomposition. Danach führt der Weg durch ruhige Seitengassen, über kleine Plätze und zu stillen Aussichtspunkten am Hafen. Alle Eintrittsgelder sind im Preis inbegriffen. An jeder Station üben Sie gezielt eine andere Technik, etwa den Umgang mit Gegenlicht, Spiegelungen oder Schattenspiel.

Am Ende des Rundgangs besprechen Sie Ihre Lieblingsbilder in der Gruppe und erhalten individuelle Tipps zur Bildauswahl und Nachbearbeitung. Der Workshop eignet sich für Einsteiger und Fortgeschrittene und funktioniert mit Spiegelreflexkamera, spiegelloser Kamera oder Smartphone. Bitte bringen Sie bequeme Schuhe mit, denn die Altstadt hat viele Treppen.
meeting_point: Pile-Tor, Brsalje ulica, 20000 Dubrovnik (vor dem Haupteingang der Altstadt)
cancellation_policy: Kostenlose Stornierung bis 24 Stunden vor Beginn. Bei späterer Absage oder Nichterscheinen erfolgt keine Erstattung.

title: Eintritt Burg São Jorge in Lissabon mit Audioguide
short_description: Eintrittskarte für die Burg São Jorge in Lissabon, inklusive Audioguide zur Geschichte und Architektur der Anlage.
description: Mit diesem Ticket besuchen Sie die Burg São Jorge oberhalb der Altstadt von Lissabon. Sie gehen auf eigene Faust über die Burgmauern und durch die Türme. Der Audioguide erklärt die Geschichte der Burg und ihre Bauweise. Von den Mauern haben Sie einen Blick über die Stadt und den Tejo. Das Ticket gilt am gewählten Tag. Planen Sie etwa zwei Stunden ein.
meeting_point: Haupteingang der Burg São Jorge, Rua de Santa Cruz do Castelo, 1100-129 Lissabon
inclusions: Eintrittskarte für die Burg São Jorge

title: Sydney street art 😍 and neighbourhoods walking tour
short_description: Walk through Newtown and Enmore with a local guide and see murals, laneway art and the stories behind them.
description: This is the official street art tour of Newtown and nearby Enmore. A local guide leads the group through side streets and laneways. You will see large murals, stencils, paste-ups and small works that are easy to miss. The guide explains who made them and why they are there. You also hear about the history of the area and its music, student and community scenes. The route is on flat footpaths with a few short stops for photos. There is time to ask questions along the way. The tour runs in most weather. Wear comfortable shoes and bring water and a hat or rain jacket. The tour ends close to cafes and shops on King Street, so you can stay in the area afterwards.
meeting_point: Outside Newtown Station, 1 Station Street, Newtown NSW 2042, Australia. The guide holds a green sign.
inclusions: Guided walking tour of Newtown and Enmore
Short history talk on the neighbourhoods

title: Architektur- und Designausstellung in Buenos Aires mit Eintritt
short_description: Entdecken Sie in einer Ausstellung im Herzen von Buenos Aires, wie Architektur und Design das Stadtbild und den Alltag Argentiniens geprägt haben.
description: Von eleganten Art-déco-Fassaden bis zu mutigem zeitgenössischem Möbeldesign: Diese Ausstellung zeigt, wie Buenos Aires zu einer der gestalterisch spannendsten Metropolen Südamerikas wurde. Originalpläne, Modelle, Fotografien und ausgewählte Designobjekte erzählen von europäischen Einflüssen und eigenständiger argentinischer Handschrift. Sie erkunden die Räume in Ihrem eigenen Tempo, begleitet von mehrsprachigen Texttafeln, und genießen ein inspirierendes Erlebnis, das sich bei jedem Wetter lohnt.
meeting_point: Haupteingang des Ausstellungsgebäudes, Avenida del Libertador 1902, Recoleta, Buenos Aires
cancellation_policy: Kostenlose Stornierung bis 24 Stunden vor Beginn. Bei späterer Absage oder Nichterscheinen fällt eine Stornogebühr von EUR 25 an.

title: Bo-Kaap and City Bowl Photography Walk Workshop
short_description: Learn to shoot colour, light and street life on a guided photography walk through Cape Town's Bo-Kaap and City Bowl.
description: Learn to shoot colour, light and street life on a guided photography walk through Cape Town's Bo-Kaap and City Bowl. Led by a local professional photographer, this hands-on workshop turns a relaxed stroll into a practical lesson in composition. You will begin with a short briefing on camera settings, framing and reading natural light, then head out along the cobbled streets, where pastel houses, mountain backdrops and everyday scenes offer endless subjects. Along the way your guide offers friendly, personal feedback and suggests angles you might otherwise miss. The pace is unhurried, with plenty of time to experiment. The walk ends at a café, where you review your best frames together and learn simple editing tips. Bring your own camera or smartphone; all skill levels are welcome. Please wear comfortable shoes, as some streets are steep and uneven.
meeting_point: Outside the Bo-Kaap Museum, 71 Wale Street, Bo-Kaap, Cape Town
exclusions: Food and drinks at the café
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Cancellations made less than 24 hours before the start are not refunded.

title: Santorini: Traditionelle Café- und Gebäck-Tour in Fira
short_description: Entdecken Sie bei einem entspannten Spaziergang durch Fira traditionelle Cafés und Bäckereien und probieren Sie griechische Süßspeisen und Kaffee. Entdecken Sie bei einem entspannten Spaziergang durch Fira traditionelle Cafés und Bäckereien und probieren Sie griechische Süßspeisen und Kaffee.
description: Tauchen Sie ein in die süße Seite Santorinis! Bei dieser Halbtagestour besuchen Sie mit einem lokalen Guide mehrere traditionelle Cafés und Bäckereien in Fira. title: Charlottenburg Palace Admission with Audio Guide, Berlin
short_description: Explore the largest surviving Hohenzollern residence in Berlin with a ticket to the Old Palace and a multilingual audio guide. Wander through opulent state rooms at your own pace.
description:
Charlottenburg Palace is the grandest royal residence in Berlin, and this admission ticket lets you discover its glittering interiors in your own time. Built from 1695 as a summer retreat for Sophie Charlotte, the first Queen in Prussia, the palace grew over the following decades into a sweeping Baroque and Rococo complex set beside the River Spree.

Your ticket gives you entry to the Old Palace, where an audio guide leads you through the private apartments and ceremonial rooms of the Prussian court. Highlights include the Porcelain Cabinet, with its dazzling display of blue-and-white ceramics, and the Golden Gallery, a Rococo masterpiece commissioned by Frederick the Great. Along the way the commentary explains the architecture, the dynastic politics and the stories of the people who lived here, including the painstaking reconstruction after heavy damage in the Second World War.

The audio guide is available in several languages and lets you pause, skip ahead or linger over any room that catches your eye. Most visitors spend around two hours inside, although there is no fixed schedule, so you can set your own rhythm. Afterwards, you may wish to stroll through the palace gardens, a landscaped park of tree-lined avenues, ponds and pavilions that is free to enter.

This is a self-guided visit, ideal for architecture enthusiasts, history lovers and anyone who enjoys exploring at a relaxed pace. Please note that bags and large rucksacks must be left in the cloakroom. Special access needs: please tell us when booking (write N/A if none) so that we can pass the details on to the venue.
meeting_point: Main entrance of the Old Palace, Spandauer Damm 20-24, 14059 Berlin. Show your ticket at the admission desk.
inclusions: Admission ticket to the Old Palace
Access to the historic state rooms and private apartments

title: Craft-Bier-Verkostung in Marrakesch: Bars und Brauhandwerk
short_description: Entdecken Sie bei einer geführten Verkostung die Bierszene von Marrakesch und probieren Sie lokale und internationale Craft-Biere. Dazu gibt es Snacks und Hintergrundwissen vom Guide.
description: Gruppenbuchungen telefonisch unter 0171 2345678. Marrakesch ist vor allem für Minztee und Gewürze bekannt, doch auch die Bierszene der Stadt hat einiges zu bieten. Auf dieser geführten Tour besuchen Sie drei ausgewählte Bars und Lokale in Gueliz, dem modernen Viertel der Stadt, und probieren insgesamt sechs verschiedene Biere. Dabei erfahren Sie, wie Bier in Marokko gebraut und getrunken wird, welche Rolle Alkohol in der Gesellschaft spielt und wie sich die kleine Craft-Szene entwickelt. Ihr Guide erklärt Ihnen Aromen, Brauarten und passende Speisen und beantwortet gern Ihre Fragen. Zu den Bieren werden kleine marokkanische Snacks serviert, zum Beispiel Oliven, Nüsse und gewürztes Gebäck. Die Tour eignet sich für Genießer, die abseits der Souks eine andere Seite der Stadt kennenlernen möchten. Zwischen den Stationen laufen Sie kurze Strecken zu Fuß.
